name: sf-guardian
description: Salesforce helper for Claude Code: production deploy guard, org badge, live Files sidebar with diffs, compact sf rows and test summaries, Apex test tracking, coverage, and org limits

prod_orgs.title: Production orgs
prod_orgs.description: Aliases or usernames of your production orgs, separated by commas (for example: prod, admin@acme.com). Deploys and data changes aimed at these ask first.

auto_open_files.title: Open the Files sidebar automatically
auto_open_files.description: Open the live Files sidebar the first time a file changes in a session.

files_pane_width.title: Files sidebar width
files_pane_width.description: Width of the Files sidebar in terminal columns.

compact_sf_rows.title: Compact sf command rows
compact_sf_rows.description: Draw sf deploys and Apex test runs as short rows with a summary. Ctrl+O still shows everything.

show_band.title: Org status above the prompt
show_band.description: Show the org badge, untested Apex, changed files and the last deploy above the prompt.

coverage_target.title: Coverage target (%)
coverage_target.description: Coverage at or above this shows green. Below 75% shows red.
